referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Waste-specific emissions from lignite spoil leachate. Short- and long-term emissions to groundwater from rainwater infiltration leaching. Leaching by lateral groundwater flow not included.; Geography: Data represents a worldwide average. Generic water infiltration rate according to weighted mean of major sites of coal tailings production in the world.
referenceFunction.localName: Disposal, tailings from hard coal milling, in impoundment
referenceFunction.name: Disposal, tailings from hard coal milling, in impoundment

geography.text: Data represents a worldwide average. Generic water infiltration rate according to weighted mean of major sites of coal tailings production in the world.

technology.text: Mechanically stable and revegetated coal tailings impoundment

timePeriod.text: Average coal tailings composition from literature references. Transfer coefficients from prospective model, specific to coal tailings.

representativeness.extrapolations: missing values adopted by proxy from lignite spoil
representativeness.productionVolume: Approx. 1167 Mio t/a coal tailings generation
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Disposal model based on observed leachate concentrations in literature. Extrapolated to 60'000 years heeding chemical characteristics. Initial tailings composition from various literature sources.
representativeness.uncertaintyAdjustments: Uncertainty of waste input composition data derived from large literature survey. Mean long-term emissions are the emissions during a generic ecological planning horizon (60'000a). Maximal (upper boundary) long-term emissions represent the complete emissions of all landfilled material.
